በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
በአፈ: አፍ — by the mouth of (በ- + noun, construct አፈ)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ቀዳማዊ: ቀዳማዊ — first (adjective, masc. sg.; ቀዳማዊ ብእሲ 'the first man')
በዕለተ: ዕለት — on the day of (በ- + noun, construct 'day-of')
ኀይል: ኀይል — strength, might (noun; construct ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons of strength', i.e. the mighty)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
ፈጠረ: ፈጠረ — he created (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r)
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
በቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — in the first (በ- + adjective used as noun 'first, former')
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
በክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — in, by Christ (በ- + proper name)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ዘብዴዎስ: ዘብዴዎስ — Zebedee (proper name; ወልደ ዘብዴዎስ 'son of Zebedee')
ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
ዘሰማዕነ: ሰምዐ — what we heard, that which we heard (ዘ- + 1cp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?)
ወአንትሙኒ: አንትሙ — and you too (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ትከውኑ: ኮነ — you (mp) are, will be (2mp imperfect, k-w-n)
ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
ገበርነ: ገብረ — we do (1cp perfect, G, after ለእመ 'if')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
ቤዛ: ቤዛ — ransom, redemption (noun; ቤዛ ይስሐቅ 'ransom of Isaac', construct)
ወንሕነኒ: ንሕነ — and we too (ወ- + 1cp pronoun + emphatic -ኒ)
አመነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect of አምነ 'believe, have faith', with በ- 'in'; after plural እለ, an irregular match: distributive, or slip for አመኑ (?))
ለነቢያት: ነቢይ — of the prophets (ለ- + plural ነቢያት; names the owner after the suffix)
በጸጋሁ: ጸጋ — by his grace (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
ጠይቅ: ጠየቀ — examine, investigate (2ms imperative, G, ṭ-y-q)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
ወኢምንተኒ: ምንት — and not anything, nothing (ወ- + ኢ- + 'what' + -ኒ 'also')
አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)
ያርኢ: አርአየ — he shows (3ms imperfect, a-stem causative of ርእየ 'see')
ዘተብህለ: ተብህለ — which was said (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect passive of ብህለ)
ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
ወምንተ: ምንት — and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative pronoun, accusative)
ለአይሁድ: አይሁድ — to the Jews (ለ- + plural noun) · ለ- marking the object (ያስተኀፍርዎሙ ለአይሁድ 'they shame the Jews')
ወአበዩ: አበየ — and they refused (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-b-y)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ)
ለሰብእ: ሰብእ — for man, as men (ለ- + noun 'man, human being') · 'of man' (ለ- as genitive link after a suffixed noun: ዕበይነ ለሰብእ 'our greatness, of man')
አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
በዕልወቱ: ዕልወት — in his ዕልወት (በ- 'in, by' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; perhaps 'perversity'; sense unclear) (?)
ተሰቂሎ: ተሰቅለ — having been hanged, hanged (converb, 3ms, passive ተ-stem of ሰቀለ)
መስቀል: መስቀል — cross (noun; genitive after the construct ዕፀ)
በእንቲአነ: በእንተ — for our sake, on our account (preposition, stem በእንቲአ- + -ነ '1cp us')
ሐመ: ሐመ — he was ill (3ms perfect, G, ḥ-m-m)
መለኮቱ: መለኮት — his divinity, godhead (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', form መለኮቱ)
ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity') · 'for ever' as an adverb after a noun (ደዌ ዘለዓለም 'sickness for ever')
ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died' · noun 'death' in the figura etymologica ከመ ሞተ ኢትሙቱ 'that you not die the death' (?) · death (ሞት, noun, accusative; ነሣእነ ሞተ ወሕይወተ 'we have taken death and life')
መሬታዊ: መሬታዊ — earthly, of the earth (adjective; formed on መሬት 'earth, soil', a word I could not check in Dillmann; here 'earthly one(s)') (?)
አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ)
አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)
ወወሃቤ: ወሃቢ — and giver of (ወ- + agent noun, construct ወሃቤ)
ወበእንተዝኬ: በእንተዝ — and therefore, for this reason (ወ- + በእንተ + ዝ 'this' + -ኬ)
ኵሎ: ኵሉ — all (accusative) · 'everything', used alone (እሰፍን ኵሎ 'I measure everything')
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ሐሰዉ: ሐሰወ — lie, speak falsely (3mp perfect, G, ḥ-s-w)
ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-) · 'against' (ወቀንኡ ላዕሌሁ 'and they envied him', lit. 'against him', ch. 95) (?)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ያአምር: አእመረ — he knows, discerns (3ms imperfect, caus., ʿ-m-r)
ወሎቱሰ: ለ — and him, as for him (ወ- + ሎቱ 'to him' + contrastive -ሰ; ለ- marks the object, ወሎቱሰ ፈጠርክዎ 'but him I created')
ወሶበሰ: ሶበ — and if, and when (ወ- 'and' + conjunction + emphatic -ሰ)
አእመሩ: አእመረ — they knew (3mpl perfect, a-stem, ʿ-m-r)
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
ኢሰቀልዎ: ሰቀለ — they did not crucify him (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, s-q-l, + -ዎ '3ms him')
ዘኢያአምሩ: አእመረ — which they do not know (ዘ- 'which' + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp imperfect, IV, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
